from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document parsed from the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as found in the text")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The specific case cause (案由) recorded in the document text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
